head: Google AI Ultra now includes YouTube Premium Family for 5 members
dek: Google AI Ultra subscribers now get YouTube Premium Family, which covers up to five family members in one household, instead of the Individual plan. It applies to Ultra 5x at 99.99 dollars a month and Ultra 20x at 199.99 dollars a month.
details: YouTube Premium brings ad-free YouTube and YouTube Music, background play and downloads. On its own, the Family plan costs 26.99 dollars a month. Google AI Pro, at 19.99 dollars a month, still comes with YouTube Premium Lite, which leaves out YouTube Music. Ultra 5x also has 20 terabytes of storage and Ultra 20x has 30.
where: Google AI Ultra 5x and 20x subscribers, from 18 November
means: If you already pay for Google AI Ultra, your household can now share ad-free YouTube without paying for a separate family plan.
todo: If you pay for YouTube Premium Family separately and also have AI Ultra, check your Google subscriptions so you don't pay twice.
thumb_words: AI ULTRA ADDS YOUTUBE PREMIUM FAMILY
